evidence.observation: Earlier A close-up shows a tall, strongly C-curved body with head held high/right and tail low.
evidence.distinguishes_because: This body shape and orientation are not the more horizontal, shallow-curved form seen for X, so X is unlikely to be A.

evidence.observation: Current X close-up shows a more horizontal, shallow-curved body with head to the right.
evidence.distinguishes_because: This matches the earlier B-like shape rather than the strongly curved A, supporting X=B.

evidence.observation: Current Y close-up shows a tall, curved C-like body with head high and tail low, closely resembling the earlier A close-up.
evidence.distinguishes_because: This supports Y=A, consistent only with C1 rather than C2.
